reference_sql:
SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_lines ol
  WHERE ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id
    AND ol.quantity >= 3
)
alternatives:
SELECT promo_id, promo_code
FROM promotions
WHERE promo_id NOT IN (
  SELECT promo_id
  FROM order_lines
  WHERE quantity >= 3
    AND promo_id IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id AND ol.quantity >= 3
WHERE ol.order_line_id IS NULL

other_way.sql:
SELECT pr.promo_id, pr.promo_code
FROM promotions pr
LEFT JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = pr.promo_id AND ol.quantity >= 3
WHERE ol.order_line_id IS NULL
other_way.tradeoff: A LEFT JOIN that keeps unmatched promotions works too, but its quantity test must sit in ON, which is easy to get wrong.
